## Re-review of PR #3880 (head `230d46e0b`): ready for the maintainer to merge

The new commit closes the earlier blocker. The code, tests and goldens are unchanged since `a326fb2d7`. Only the decision record changed, and the PR body changed. Both now describe the final change.

### What changed since `a326fb2d7`

`git diff a326fb2d7..230d46e0b` touches one file: `docs/decisions/3671-3d-pocket-interlevel-rapid-margin.md` (+20/-13). The PR body was edited on GitHub, so it is not in the diff.

### What looks good

- No rapid goes lower than before. On a level transition the descent start rises by `plunge_height`. On a pass restart the start plane stays at `a.prev_z`, and only the rapid stop rises, followed by a feed. No rapid is lost and no clearance plane is lowered.
- No test is removed or weakened, and no `#[ignore]` is added.
- The `Changelog:` line is present, the body ends `Fixes #3671`, and the commit subjects are conventional (`fix(motion): ...`, `docs(decisions): ...`). No process file, no `.cargo/` directory and no dependency change.

### Earlier findings

1. **PR body and decision record did not describe the final change (blocker). Closed.**
   - The body has a "Goldens moved" section. It names `rough-finish.nc` and `.camproj` (77 rapids stop 2 mm higher: 6 inter-level entries and 71 pass restarts), and the `rotary_adaptive.rs` `GOLDEN_RINGS` move from `(2363, 10_359_925_331_182_573_356)` to `(2387, 3_362_882_240_517_259_677)`, with the reason.
   - The body's "What changed" now describes `Ask.restart`, the level-transition case and the pass-restart case, and names all three callers (`push_helix`, `push_zig3`, the diagonal ramp arm).
   - The "Pinning tests" list names all 5 `catalog_3d_rough_finish` cases, including the two #3670 safety pins.
   - The decision record gives both cases, explains why the pass-restart baseline stays at `a.prev_z`, and the "Considered and dropped" entry now reads "modifying caller sites without a `restart` flag", which matches `ladder.rs:374`.
   - I checked the record against the unchanged code: `descent.rs:60-79` (`from`), `descent.rs:230-236` (`push_helix`), `descent.rs:243-250` (`push_zig3`), `descent.rs:324-331` (diagonal ramp). The record is faithful.
2. **Optional: a motion-level restart-margin test.** Still absent. The named pin reads the recorded `.nc` file; `regenerates` is the real pin. Optional, as before.
3. **Optional: diagonal ramp arm angle limit.** Unchanged. A follow-up, not a blocker.
4. **Optional: shortened comments at `ladder.rs:231` and `ladder.rs:363`.** Text only.

### Results (merged with `origin/main` `98caf2dfd`, clean `--no-ff` merge, no conflicts; built and run locally)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog catalog_3d_rough_finish` | 5 passed, 0 failed (41 filtered out) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test machining3d` | 23 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test level_links` | 12 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test entry_approach` | 9 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test circular_ramp_angle` | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test rotary_adaptive` | 3 passed, 0 failed, 3 ignored (heavy lane) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog -- -D warnings` | clean |

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` fails. The cause is on `main`, and this PR does not touch it. I checked `origin/main`: `WireContourOp` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/wire_edm.rs:47`) has no `start` field, but `crates/app/tests/wire_dxf_selection/arcs.rs:49` and `:135` still set `start:`. The exact error:

```
error[E0560]: struct `camcraft_app::operation::WireContourOp` has no field named `start`
  --> crates/app/tests/wire_dxf_selection/arcs.rs:49:9
```

This is a red `main` (P2) for the maintainer, not a finding on this PR.

### Targeted tests

- Example catalog: `catalog_3d_rough_finish` (5 tests above), because the PR changes a toolpath.
- Light lane: not run. The code did not change since `a326fb2d7`, so the earlier head's code results stand; only the doc and the body changed.
- Heavy lane: none. This is a P3 PR, so it gets no heavy step.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The body says "All modified files remain under 400 lines (`descent.rs` is 396 lines; `ladder.rs` is 436 lines, reduced from 438 lines on main)". The measured counts are `descent.rs` 396 (PR) against 368 (main), and `ladder.rs` 444 (PR) against 445 (main). The line-count sentence is inaccurate, and `ladder.rs` is over 400 lines. This is not a violation: the file was already over 400 on main and it shrank. Correct the numbers when convenient.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
